title: Memory stocks face headwinds as 'smart money' walks out
description: Memory stocks showed initial promise but are now faltering, weighed down by anxiety surrounding the artificial intelligence market. Sandisk and Western Digital reported declines, while Micron and Seagate experienced modest increases.
